snippet.title: Guns of Eschaton - Official Developer Vision Overview
snippet.description:
Check out this all new Developer Vision Video for Guns of Eschaton, the new Soulslike FPS set in a dark Western inspired world! The late Viktor Antonov and Creative Director, Fuad Kuliev sit down and discuss the vision behind Guns of Eschaton. Touching on the genre blend, the world, the art direction, and more! 
Guns of Eschaton coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
